rationale: Cheapest useful Meta spend: people who already reached the campaign site or doviloop.dev. Works regardless of how small the prospecting audience is, because intent has already been shown.
source: One shared Meta pixel, id 1584074833462346. Installed and firing on campaign-site-azure.vercel.app since 2026-09-12. Not yet confirmed on doviloop.dev. See campaigns/pixel-install.md
blocked_on: NOT the pixel - it is live. Blocked on TIME: collection started 2026-09-12, so the pool is about six days deep as of 2026-09-18. It needs to be filling well before the ads run or there is nobody in it on launch day.
verified: 2026-09-18, twice and independently. campaign-build-status-9j9194 read the deployed bundle on 2026-09-12; this branch fetched https://campaign-site-azure.vercel.app/assets/index-CE-s-AfO.js on 2026-09-18 and found VITE_META_PIXEL_ID=1584074833462346 with the fbevents loader present. Configured is not the same as firing: injection stays consent-gated at runtime.
note: Covers campaign-site traffic. A pixel on www.doviloop.dev would widen it, but that site has no consent mechanism at all while already running RB2B and PostHog to a US host - see docs/BUSINESS-MANAGER-WALKTHROUGH.md section 8. Not a paste job.
_history: Until 2026-09-14 this field read 'Meta pixel is not installed on either domain yet'. True when written, not now. The blocker moved rather than cleared, which is easy to miss: an audience that is empty because it just started collecting looks exactly like an audience that is empty because nothing is wired.
_correction: Branch claude/great-bell-10ca2r independently wrote 'VITE_META_PIXEL_ID is not set' here on 2026-09-16 and carried it for two days, overwriting the accurate version above.
